title: Event envelope (CloudEvents 1.0 style)
description: Every event on ctx.bus, in the outbox, on Pub/Sub and on webhooks uses this envelope. Events carry ids and codes, never PII; consumers fetch details through the API. On Pub/Sub binary mode the attributes are ce-specversion, ce-type, ce-source, ce-id, ce-time, ce-subject and tenantid (CloudEvents extension names are lowercase). In process (ctx.bus handlers, outbox.event column) core emits the CloudEvents extension attribute `tenantid` and source `/fnol-platform`; every external surface (GET /integrations/outbox, webhooks, adapters) normalises to this schema (`tenantId`, `/tenants/<id>/modules/<module>`, `sequence`).

id.description: Unique event id (evt_...). Consumers must be idempotent on id.

subject.description: claimId for claim.* events; tenantId for tenant.* events.

correlationId.description: Request or intake session that started the chain.

causationId.description: Id of the event that caused this one.

sequence.description: Per-tenant monotonic outbox sequence (core outbox.seq column, S2-PLT-01). Strictly increasing per tenant, never reused, may have gaps for filtered reads.

tenantid.description: CloudEvents extension spelling used by the in-process bus. External consumers read tenantId; when both are present they are equal.
